messages:
oliver: Kicking off final tidy for release notes + changelog for tomorrow's docs deploy (v0.11.0). Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1319. Need: 3 user bullets, a 1-line migration for SDKs, localization heads-up, and any Known Issues.
maria: I'll draft the three bullets and a short migration table for integrators. I also want to run the relnotes-generation script to ensure canonical formatting (it adds the release-tag metadata).
ben: I'll handle SDK snippets. Plan: two very small examples (py + js) showing streaming param and prefix cache enable. Keep each snippet <= 5 lines. Also bump the client example to show v1.2.0 usage.
izzy: Doing a link and anchor sweep now. Found one expired gist in examples/prefix-cache.md and an old anchor guides/rollouts.md#canary that should be #canary-deploy. I'll replace the gist with an inline snippet and patch the anchor.
oliver: Important: we need localization notices for fr/es teams — can we add a short note so translations are queued? Something like: "Translations: FR/ES pending; ship en-US now, enqueue localization post-merge."
maria: Yep adding that under Release Ops. Also adding a 1-sentence TL;DR for the announcement channel and a slightly longer blurb for the changelog page.
ben: Snippets: python example will be single-line: `Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY')).generate('Summarize', streaming=True)`; JS example similar. Also including a one-line migration: "If you rely on non-streaming behavior, set streaming=false in client calls."
izzy: Link-check also found a broken DocSearch anchor used in header metadata; I'll update the release metadata slug to avoid index collisions. Pushing small fix.
oliver: Known Issues: 1) embeddings may 429 under sustained high concurrency when Dedicated burst is active (repro: `wrk -t6 -c150 -d30s https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings`); mitigation: client backoff or route to non-burst pool. 2) Private deployments: transient 502s may occur during canary shifts; mitigation: extend canary window or use fallback routing.
docs-bot: Heads-up: CI run queued for PR#1319 — link-check, snippet-lint, relnotes-format, and build. Expect results in ~6m.
maria: TL;DR candidate: "v0.11.0 — faster streaming, smarter batching heuristics, and small SDK changes; see migration notes." Keeping it to one sentence for the announcement.
ben: Also adding a tiny prefix-cache snippet in examples (2 lines) so users can see how to opt in: `client.enable_prefix_cache('my-prefix')` + short comment.
izzy: Pushed anchor + gist replacement. Also updated release slug and flagged localization tag.
docs-bot: CI results: link-check OK, snippet-lint WARN (one line exceeds max length by chars), relnotes-format OK, build OK.
maria: Fixing the one lint warn now (shorten the python snippet). Will push in 5.
ben: Pushed the shortened snippet. All green?
docs-bot: CI: link-check OK, snippet-lint OK, relnotes-format OK, build OK.
oliver: Great. Final reviewers: @maria @ben @izzy. If no objections by 09:00 PT tomorrow I'll merge and coordinate announcements (announce in #product, #all-hands blurb queued). Thanks all. :tada:
